claims.claim: The work of fabrication is guided by a model, such as an internal mental image or a blueprint, which precedes the actual work process and exists outside the fabricator.
qualifications: can be an image beheld by the eye of the mind or a blueprint
claims.supporting_excerpt: The actual work of fabrication is performed under the guidance of a model in accordance with which the object is constructed. This model can be an image beheld by the eye of the mind or a blueprint in which the image has already found a tentative materialization through work. In either case, what guides the work of fabrication is outside the fabricator and precedes the actual work process

claims.claim: The process of making is entirely determined by the categories of means and end, culminating in a durable end product that is independent of the production process itself.
qualifications: when an entirely new thing with enough durability to remain in the world as an independent entity has been added
claims.supporting_excerpt: The process of making is itself entirely determined by the categories of means and end. The fabricated thing is an end product in the twofold sense that the production process comes to an end in it... and that it is only a means to produce this end.

definitions.definition: The act of multiplying something that already possesses a relatively stable, relatively permanent existence in the world, distinct from mere biological repetition.

distinctions.distinction: Multiplication multiplies something that already possesses a relatively stable, relatively permanent existence in the world, whereas repetition is urged upon and remains subject to the biological cycle.

must_not_be_lost: Fabrication is guided by an external or mental model that survives the finished product.
Making is determined by the categories of means and end, unlike the cyclic necessity of labor.
output.segment_function: Examines the characteristics of fabrication, contrasting its reliance on models, the means-end category, and product multiplication with the biological repetition and consumption inherent in labor.
